The sign-out sentence is verified verbatim: 'If you change or reset your password, you'll be signed out everywhere except:'. The ref's iPhone or iPad applicability is confirmed. This ref is a distractor for the clarify route and is correctly unused.

Page's Android phone & tablet section starts 'Open your device's Settings app.' then tap Google, your name, and 'Manage your Google Account'. The sign-out sentence is verified verbatim. The ref's Android applicability is confirmed. This ref is a distractor for the clarify route and is correctly unused.

required_actions.action: Find out whether the tablet is an iPad or an Android tablet, since the steps differ
Use the iPad steps (open the Gmail app, then Manage your Google Account) only if the tablet is an iPad
Use the Android steps (open Settings, tap Google, then Manage your Google Account) only if the tablet is an Android tablet
